{{Hatnote|For the 2007 consolidated book, see [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1]].}}
The '''Players Committee Rules Supplement''' of 27 January 2003 is an official [[Players Committee]] rules document for early [[Virtual Original]] play.<ref name="supp2003">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030822212619/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGRules01-27-03.pdf SWCCGRules01-27-03.pdf], theforce.net (Wayback, 22 August 2003; updated 27 January 2003). Wiki copy: [[:File:SWCCG-Rules-Supplement-2003.pdf]].</ref> It supplements Decipher [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0|Rulebook 2.0]], [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]], and the [[Decipher Glossary Supplement]] of 29 January 2002.<ref name="supp2003" />

The two-page sheet includes rulings on original (V) cards such as Blaster Rack (V) and Sai'torr Kal Fas (V).<ref name="supp2003" /> [[Greg Anderson]] is named as the rules contact.<ref name="supp2003" />

In April 2003 the Players Committee's Resources page listed Decipher's Glossary 2.0 (November 1998), the Glossary Supplement (29 January 2002), this Rules Supplement (27 January 2003) and the Classic Format ban list (31 March 2003).<ref name="pc-resources03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030423193822/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/resources.htm Resources] (April 2003), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 23 April 2003.</ref> Rules Advocate [[Greg Anderson]] then issued updated rules sheets on 28 April 2003,<ref name="pc-apr03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030810085606/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/april03archives.htm April 03 Updates], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 10 August 2003.</ref> 19 June 2003,<ref name="pc-jun03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20031016172417/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/june03archives.htm June 03 Updates], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 16 October 2003.</ref> 23 August 2003 (final version 25 August 2003, "the official version that will be used at Worlds", with a new "Starting The Game" entry)<ref name="pc-aug03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040612215836/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/august03archives.htm August 03 Updates], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 12 June 2004.</ref> and 9 February 2004.<ref name="pc-int0404">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040415220046/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm SWCCGPC.com news (December 2003 – April 2004)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 15 April 2004.</ref>

[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1]] later replaced previous rulebooks.
